summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K furnishing a voluntary announcement regarding the trustee's on-market purchase of 100,000 existing shares at an average price of HK$39.77 per share (total consideration HK$3,977,000) for the company's 2022 RSU scheme. This is a routine share purchase to satisfy RSU vesting obligations, not a tender offer, capital return, or other special situation. The trustee holds 2,265,000 shares and will not exercise voting rights. No new awards were granted. This filing is an ordinary disclosure by a foreign private issuer; no special-situation event is present.
